name: Noda Sakura
source:
She is a lively girl with short hair. She is the captain of the softball team.

She is not particular about anything, or rather, she lives her life haphazardly.

She is popular with the boys because of her openness.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/authoringheaven/futariha.html]official site[/url]]
